title: onprem: airgap offline bundle vendoring + Oracle Linux (OL) and RKE2 distro support
author: Priya Nair
description: Adds Oracle Linux (OL) packaging and vendoring to the on-prem/airgapped offline bundle pipeline and introduces RKE2-specific hooks and manifests to the private installer. Motivation: several enterprise customers requested OL (OL8/OL9) compatibility for air-gapped installs and RKE2 variant configurations to match their distro choices. This PR implements: 1) new vendors/ol directory with container/image manifests and packaging scripts; 2) TUF metadata generation updates to include OL vendor artifacts and reproducible signing; 3) Helm chart tweaks to tolerations and nodeSelector handling for RKE2 nodes; 4) terraform module updates to expose an optional "kube_distro" variable and map RKE2-specific kubelet flags; 5) an image mirroring script and catalog used by offline bundle builder; 6) e2e airgap test additions that run a minimal RKE2/OEL install in CI's airgap runner. The description below summarizes changes, test plan, and rollout notes.

review_comments: Evan Chen: Can we make the OL packaging idempotent across reruns? I hit a checksum drift when rebuilding the bundle locally.

Priya Nair: The idempotency issue was due to tar timestamps and order of file serialization; updated build-pack.sh to normalize timestamps and sort file lists before tar. Added a reproducible build step in packaging tests.
Liam O'Connor: Helm changes look good but we should avoid forcing nodeSelector for mixed clusters. Can you make the rke2 defaults permissive?
Priya Nair: Updated node-affinity template to only apply nodeSelector/tolerations when kube_distro == "rke2" and left explicit opt-in via values.yaml. Added unit test for template rendering.
Marisol Gomez: CI airgap job failed initially on containerd version mismatch; we should document supported containerd versions in the bundle README.
Priya Nair: Added containerd version matrix to docs/onprem/airgap-ol-rke2.md and added a CI gate that validates the containerd shim in the mirrored images.
Evan Chen: Please add a migration note for customers upgrading from older offline bundles.
Priya Nair: Added release_notes entry and upgrade instructions; the installer supports a safe point-in-time rollback on manifest mismatch.
Evan Chen: Approved after CI green and doc updates.
checks_summary: CI: airgap-builder (pipelines) — passed after two runs (initial flaky e2e failure fixed); lint — passed; unit tests — passed; packaging smoke — passed; integration e2e/airgap — passed (rke2-ol smoke). A transient failure in packaging smoke was traced to tar ordering and fixed in a follow-up commit.
release_notes: Added Oracle Linux (OL8/OL9) vendor support for offline bundles; added optional kube_distro=rke2 support in the private installer terraform module and Helm charts; image mirroring script and TUF metadata fixes improve reproducible offline bundle builds. Upgrade notes: customers using older bundles should regenerate their offline artifacts with the new mirror script; the installer supports safe manifest rollbacks.
